_meta.name: retrieval_heldout_synthetic_v1
_meta.provenance: 20 queries written after the thresholds were set and BEFORE the retriever was run on them (the author had seen the corpus, not the retriever's output on these queries); no floor was tuned on them. Hand-written by the retriever's author and labelled against retrieval_corpus_synthetic.jsonl BEFORE the run that produced the numbers in docs/evaluation/retrieval.md. relevant = EVERY passage that states the answer fact (usually 1-5); an empty list marks an out-of-corpus query that must return nothing. Same author as the retriever, so NOT an independent test and NOT real-world accuracy.
_meta.description: held-out slice, reported separately from the tuning set.
